0022600152.text: The Timberwolves (4-2, 2-1 on the road, on a one-game winning streak) are 6th in the West and 0.5 games back in the Northwest, while the Spurs (3-2, 2-0 at home... no, 1-2 at home and 2-0 on the road, on a three-game winning streak) sit 8th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery, averaging 33.3 points this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Rudy Gobert (back spasms), and San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and lost the 2025-26 playoff series 2-4, including a 139-109 defeat in Minneapolis on May 15, 2026.
